title: Player weekly projection splits
description: Per-player 18-week split of the season projection (weekly_split_v2: even split x opponent DvP x Elo tilt (QB only) x weather x venue-specific home field, renormalized to the season total; v1 documents accepted for the pre-R51 file). Player order mirrors player_projections.json. Produced by scripts/build_weekly.py, validated by scripts/validate_data.py.

updated_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last regeneration.

tilt_coef.description: Elo matchup-tilt coefficient — the transparent prior the P2 optimizer refits in-season.

estimate.description: true => NOT a validated measurement (honesty flag).

injury_shape.description: Present ONLY when at least one player's split was shaped by data/injuries.json (Out 0.55 / Doubtful 0.7 / Questionable 0.9 on the first 3 non-bye weeks, season total unchanged). statuses_used = players shaped.

availability.description: Present ONLY when at least one player's weeks were actually blocked by a long-term absence (IR/PUP/NFI/suspension, or a parsed duration). Distinct from injury_shape on purpose: shaping PRESERVES the season total, this REDUCES it.

vocab_version.description: scripts/availability.py vocabulary version the status codes below were written with.

unavailable.description: Players whose weeks were actually zeroed. A flagged-but-unblocked row (a suspension of unstated length) is NOT counted — it claims no duration.

season_ending.description: Of those, the ones whose own report text says out for the season.

min_weeks_rule.description: The documented NFL floor applied to an IR/PUP/NFI row with no parsed duration (availability.MIN_WEEKS_OUT). A FLOOR, never a measurement.

season_points_removed.description: Sum of every player's season_points_lost — the honest headline for how many projected points left the model.

dvp_shrink.description: R51 weekly_split_v2: D = 1 + dvp_shrink x (F - 1), F = opponent's allowed PPR/game to the position over the league average (data/dvp_positional_history.json), clamped [0.75, 1.25].

elo_tilt_positions.description: Positions the Elo matchup tilt applies to (R51: QB only; RB/WR/TE measured worse under the tilt).

weather.description: Weather multipliers + thresholds (pass_dome, pass_outdoors, pass_cold_extra, rb_wind, cold_c, wind_kph) - documented priors; roof from environment_model.json, forecast from weather_forecast.json.

weather_sources.description: R56: where the weather rows came from - the Open-Meteo forecast horizon (days) that produces `games` rows and the minimum games per stadium-month behind a `climatology` row in data/weather_forecast.json (docs/WEATHER_HORIZON.md).

venue.description: Venue-specific home field: 1 +/- coef x rel, rel = venue avg_home_margin / league mean, clamped; flat when the venue is missing or low_n.

neutral_counts.description: Player-weeks where a factor fell back to 1.0 for lack of data (dvp_neutral_weeks, weather_no_forecast_weeks, venue_flat_weeks), plus (R56) the outdoor player-weeks the weather factor served from a row: weather_forecast_weeks (kickoff-hour forecast, inside the 16-day horizon) and weather_climatology_weeks (stadium-month mean beyond it). Dome and retractable weeks count in none of the three. Absent data is neutral, never invented.

backtest.description: Path of the never-regress record that admits this split (data/weekly_backtest.json).

this_week.description: R77: present whenever the document was built for a current week (build_predictions always). Counts the players[].this_week blocks.

inactive.description: R79: gated by the posted game-day inactive list. Absent on a document built before R79.

depth_snapshot.description: data/depth_chart.json updated_utc the QB gate read; null when no chart was available (status still gated, depth did not).

inactives_fetched.description: R79: data/inactives.json updated_utc the gate read; null when no game was inside the inactives window (or the file was absent).

skipped_final_teams.description: Teams whose game this week was already FINAL when the split ran; never gated (a played week is not retro-zeroed).

gsis_id.description: Same key and order as player_projections.json.

receptions_prior.description: Prior-season receptions (ESPN raw statId 53); exact PPR<->Half<->Standard conversion. 0.0 when unknown.

completions_prior.description: R28/R29 — prior-season pass completions (ESPN raw statId 1), for a league that scores Sleeper pass_cmp. OPTIONAL and OMITTED when zero or unknown: a non-passer carries no key at all, because a 0 here would be a measurement rather than a silence. Not in `required` for the same reason.

league_components.description: R44: prior-season component stat line (Sleeper scoring keys -> season quantity), extracted from the kona actuals entry ONLY when it passed self-verification against ESPN's own appliedStats arithmetic. ABSENT when unverified - unknown is never a zero-filled claim. Travels together with base_applied_pts.

base_applied_pts.description: R44: what ESPN's own default-PPR table paid for exactly the mapped component ids (receptions excluded - they stay on the mode toggle). The client's league delta is applyScoring(league_components) - base_applied_pts.

bonus_games.description: R44: measured prior-season game counts at Sleeper bonus thresholds (bonus_pass_yd_300/400, bonus_rush_yd_100/200, bonus_rec_yd_100/200), counted from nflverse weekly lines with cumulative-threshold semantics. ABSENT when unmeasured, never zero.

availability.description: Present ONLY when the player carries a non-ACTIVE canonical status in data/injuries.json. The five season keys ride ONLY on a player whose weeks were actually blocked — a flagged-but-unblocked row states nothing about duration and therefore claims nothing.

class.description: week = near-term shaping, season total preserved. season = long-term absence, season total reduced. An OUT whose report text says season-ending is PROMOTED to season, so this is not derivable from status alone.

weeks_out.description: Weeks actually zeroed (what we DID). null when out_for_season. Must equal the count of weeks carrying avail:false.

confidence.description: explicit = the report stated the duration and `evidence` quotes it. rule = nothing was stated and the documented league floor was applied, so the surface must say 'at least N', never 'N'.

evidence.description: The verbatim report sentence the duration was parsed from; null for a rule-floor row, which has no report to quote.

season_points_lost.description: proj_points minus the sum of the surviving weeks. The reduction F2 never made.

this_week.description: R77 THE THIS-WEEK GATE. Present ONLY when the player is NOT playable in the current week, or when a backup quarterback is PROMOTED to start. Written by build_weekly.this_week_gate from two stated facts, never a guess: his canonical status (OUT / DOUBTFUL / IR / PUP / NFI / SUSPENDED -> reason status) or his team's latest depth chart (a QB who is not the highest-ranked PLAYABLE QB -> reason depth). QUESTIONABLE is priced and labelled, never gated. When playable is false the week row carries avail:false and pts 0.0, no prop leg is priced on him and no parlay may carry him.

reason.description: inactive = (R79) he is on his team's posted game-day inactive list (data/inactives.json). status = his injury status says he sits. depth = a listed QB behind a healthy starter (or a QB his team's chart does not list). depth_promoted = playable:true, the listed starter is out and this QB starts.

status.description: reason status only: the code that gated him (availability.NOT_PLAYABLE).

game_id.description: reason inactive only: the ESPN game whose posted list names him (data/inactives.json games[].game_id).

depth.description: reason depth / depth_promoted: his pos_rank on the team's chart; null when the chart does not list him.

starter.description: reason depth: the playable QB the chart names ahead of him.

starter_out.description: reason depth_promoted: the rank-1 QB whose status is not playable.

points_lost.description: playable:false only: what zeroing the week cost his season split (the same split without the gate, minus with it). 0.0 when the week was already a season block.

weeks.description: Always 18 rows, weeks 1..18. Non-bye pts sum to the AVAILABILITY-ADJUSTED season projection (proj_points * playable_non_bye / non_bye), within rounding.

opp.description: Canonical opponent abbreviation; null on bye.

pts.description: ESTIMATE weekly PPR points, 2dp. 0.0 on bye, 0.0 when avail is false.

avail.description: Emitted ONLY when the player cannot play this week (long-term absence). ABSENT means available, which keeps the committed diff to the affected rows instead of 5,400 cosmetic booleans. Deliberately distinguishable from bye:true — that is what lets a lineup row say BYE rather than IR.
